Hi Neha,

Hi Samir — great to hear and thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a lightweight MAP GDoc and a compact 30-day checklist that we've used for accelerated pilots. I copied Marissa (solutions) and Jonas (product ops) so they can scope the slide deck and test plan.

Quick notes / proposed compressed timeline (we can tighten based on your availability):
- Week 0 (Kickoff, 1–2 hrs): align stakeholders, share access, confirm sample data.
- Week 1 (Ingest & validation): small sample ingest, baseline latency + token-cost checks.
- Week 2 (Integration & smoke tests): integrate into a single evaluation route, run 5–10k tokens/day tests.
- Week 3 (Quality & edge cases): AC testing, prompt tuning, evaluation set runs.
- Week 4 (Acceptance & review): compile results, acceptance criteria check, executive summary + next-step SOW.

Acceptance criteria we typically include in a compressed run:
- Throughput & p50/p95 latency within agreed SLOs on your target infra.
- Quality thresholds on a small human-eval set (we'll propose a 20-example panel).
- No data exfiltration concerns; secure logging only.

Attachments included: redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc (link stub), 30d_accelerated_pilot_checklist.xlsx (checklist).

Can you confirm: primary technical contact for data access, decision-maker who will sign the pilot SOW, and any compliance questions (SOC2, data residency)? Once you confirm, we'll: 1) seed the GDoc with a tailored plan, 2) schedule a 30-min kickoff, and 3) slide up the executive summary for your COO.

Available slots for a kickoff: Thu 6/17 10–11am PT, Fri 6/18 9–11am PT. Does any of that work?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
